description: This file implements the 'EnoughData' class, which is part of a media streaming system. It manages the state indicating whether enough data has been received for audio and video streams, and updates the context accordingly when invoked.

classes.name: EnoughData
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the 'enough data' event in media streaming, updating the context to indicate whether more data is needed for audio and video streams.
